annotations.title: Check BOM parts at DigiKey and Mouser

description: Check where the parts of a BOM stand at DigiKey and Mouser right now. Give up to 10 manufacturer part numbers, each with the quantity the build needs. For each part and each distributor: whether it carries EXACTLY that part number (a different number is listed as a candidate, never as the part), stock, price breaks and the price at your quantity, lifecycle status as the distributor states it (active, not for new designs, last time buy, obsolete, discontinued at the distributor), minimum order, lead time, RoHS, export class, country of origin where the distributor gives one (Mouser), a suggested replacement, and the product and datasheet links. Three checks per part: found, stock_for_quantity, lifecycle; a lookup that failed leaves them not_checkable, never a pass. It does NOT rank one distributor against another or pick a cheapest offer, does NOT store or cache anything (stock and price are true only at retrieved_at), and does NOT place orders. Each result names its distributor as the source. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; costs no credits; limited to 100 part lookups a day per account, and a distributor whose shared daily quota is used up is reported daily_budget_reached. No model call.

distributors.description: Which distributors to ask. Default both.

parts.description: The parts to check, each once. At most 10 per call.

manufacturer.description: With it, each offer says whether the distributor's manufacturer agrees.

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number as on the BOM, for example 'MAX98357AETE+T'.

quantity.description: How many the build needs. Default 1.
